lineage.distinction: Prior cash-and-carry tested carry/basis economics as a hedged position. This lab asks whether extreme intraday Binance USD-M premium-index dislocations compress over a short fixed horizon. It is not a rescue of the closed cash-and-carry implementation.

economic_mechanism: Extreme positive perpetual premium relative to the index can attract short-perp/long-spot arbitrage and increases funding pressure, creating a short-horizon force toward premium compression. Only after source adequacy is proven may a separately frozen Discovery test that mechanism.

source.proof_method: For source gate only, request the exact .CHECKSUM companion object. Do not download ZIP market data or open OHLC/premium values.

stop_rule: If any required month/dataset/symbol lacks a valid official checksum receipt, stop as source-insufficient. Do not substitute another venue, asset, timeframe, quote currency or year under this source-gate ID.
post_pass_rule: PASS authorizes only a separately frozen pre-Discovery protocol. No economic outcome may be opened by this source gate.
